Casual
Generosity

Easy, genuinely fun ways to do something meaningful with the people you're already hanging out with — most of it completely free.

Inspired by Chris Anderson's Infectious Generosity, this is a browsable list of specific, low-effort things you can actually do this weekend. No planning, no big commitment. And it's not just a nice feeling: research consistently links doing things for others with real gains in happiness and life satisfaction. Pick one based on how much time or money you've actually got, and go.

  • Spontaneous Do it today. Nothing to book, nothing to arrange.
  • Planned Needs a date in the diary and a bit of coordinating.
  • Committed Sign up, apply or train first — then it stays available to you.
